properties.displayName: Audit Event ASIM parser for AWS CloudTrail EC2 PrivateConnectivity activity
properties.query:
let parser = (disabled: bool = false, pack: bool = false) {
  let Events = datatable(EventName: string, EventType: string, Object: string)
  [
    "AcceptVpcEndpointConnections", "Execute", "VPC",
    "ApplySecurityGroupsToClientVpnTargetNetwork", "Set", "VPC",
    "AssociateClientVpnTargetNetwork", "Set", "Client VPN Endpoint",
    "AttachVpnGateway", "Set", "VPC",
    "AuthorizeClientVpnIngress", "Execute", "Client VPN Endpoint",
    "CreateClientVpnEndpoint", "Create", "Client VPN Endpoint",
    "CreateClientVpnRoute", "Create", "Client VPN Endpoint",
    "CreateCustomerGateway", "Create", "Customer Gateway",
    "CreateVpcEndpoint", "Create", "VPC Endpoint",
    "CreateVpcEndpointConnectionNotification", "Create", "VPC Connection Notification",
    "CreateVpcEndpointServiceConfiguration", "Create", "VPC Endpoint Service",
    "CreateVpnConcentrator", "Create", "VPN Concentrator",
    "CreateVpnConnection", "Create", "VPN Connection",
    "CreateVpnConnectionRoute", "Set", "VPN Connection",
    "CreateVpnGateway", "Create", "VPC",
    "DeleteClientVpnEndpoint", "Delete", "Client VPN Endpoint",
    "DeleteClientVpnEndpointAuthorizationPolicy", "Delete", "Client VPN Endpoint Authorization Policy",
    "DeleteClientVpnRoute", "Set", "Client VPN Endpoint",
    "DeleteCustomerGateway", "Delete", "Customer Gateway",
    "DeleteVpcEndpointConnectionNotifications", "Delete", "VPC Endpoint Connection Notification",
    "DeleteVpcEndpointServiceConfigurations", "Delete", "VPC Endpoint Service",
    "DeleteVpcEndpoints", "Delete", "VPC Endpoint",
    "DeleteVpnConcentrator", "Delete", "VPN Concentrator",
    "DeleteVpnConnection", "Delete", "VPN Connection",
    "DeleteVpnConnectionRoute", "Set", "VPN Connection",
    "DeleteVpnGateway", "Delete", "VPN Gateway",
    "DescribeClientVpnAuthorizationRules", "Read", "Client VPN Endpoint",
    "DescribeClientVpnConnections", "Read", "Client VPN Endpoint",
    "DescribeClientVpnEndpoints", "Read", "Client VPN Endpoint",
    "DescribeClientVpnRoutes", "Read", "Client VPN Endpoint",
    "DescribeClientVpnTargetNetworks", "Read", "Client VPN Endpoint",
    "DescribeCustomerGateways", "Read", "Customer Gateway",
    "DescribeVpcEndpointAssociations", "Read", "VPC Endpoint",
    "DescribeVpcEndpointConnectionNotifications", "Read", "VPC Endpoint Connection Notification",
    "DescribeVpcEndpointConnections", "Read", "VPC Endpoint Connection",
    "DescribeVpcEndpointServiceConfigurations", "Read", "VPC Endpoint Service",
    "DescribeVpcEndpointServicePermissions", "Read", "Vpc Endpoint Service",
    "DescribeVpcEndpointServices", "Read", "VPC Endpoint Service",
    "DescribeVpcEndpoints", "Read", "VPC Endpoint",
    "DescribeVpnConcentrators", "Read", "VPN Concentrator",
    "DescribeVpnConnections", "Read", "VPN Connection",
    "DescribeVpnGateways", "Read", "VPN Gateway",
    "DetachVpnGateway", "Set", "VPC",
    "DisassociateClientVpnTargetNetwork", "Delete", "Target Network",
    "ExportClientVpnClientCertificateRevocationList", "Execute", "Client VPN Client",
    "ExportClientVpnClientConfiguration", "Execute", "Client VPN Client",
    "GetActiveVpnTunnelStatus", "Read", "VPN Connection",
    "GetClientVpnEndpointAuthorizationPolicy", "Read", "Client VPN Endpoint Authorization Policy",
    "GetVpnConnectionDeviceSampleConfiguration", "Read", "VPN Connection",
    "GetVpnConnectionDeviceTypes", "Read", "VPN Connection",
    "GetVpnTunnelReplacementStatus", "Read", "VPN Connection",
    "ImportClientVpnClientCertificateRevocationList", "Create", "VPN Connection",
    "ModifyClientVpnEndpoint", "Set", "Client VPN Endpoint",
    "ModifyClientVpnEndpointAuthorizationPolicy", "Set", "Client VPN Endpoint Authorization Policy",
    "ModifyVpcEndpoint", "Set", "VPC Endpoint",
    "ModifyVpcEndpointConnectionNotification", "Set", "VPC Endpoint Connection Notification",
    "ModifyVpcEndpointPayerResponsibility", "Set", "VPC Endpoint",
    "ModifyVpcEndpointServiceConfiguration", "Set", "VPC Endpoint Service",
    "ModifyVpcEndpointServicePayerResponsibility", "Set", "VPC Endpoint Service",
    "ModifyVpcEndpointServicePermissions", "Set", "VPC Endpoint Service",
    "ModifyVpnConnection", "Set", "VPN Connection",
    "ModifyVpnConnectionOptions", "Set", "VPN Connection",
    "ModifyVpnTunnelCertificate", "Set", "VPN Connection",
    "ModifyVpnTunnelOptions", "Set", "VPN Connection",
    "RejectVpcEndpointConnections", "Execute", "VPC",
    "ReplaceVpnTunnel", "Set", "VPN Connection",
    "RevokeClientVpnIngress", "Disable", "VPN Connection",
    "StartVpcEndpointServicePrivateDnsVerification", "Start", "DNS",
    "TerminateClientVpnConnections", "Stop", "Client VPN Endpoint"
  ];
  AWSCloudTrail
  | where not(disabled)
  | where EventSource == "ec2.amazonaws.com"
  | where EventName in (Events | project EventName)
  | lookup kind=inner Events on EventName
  | extend RequestParameters = todynamic(RequestParameters), ResponseElements = todynamic(ResponseElements)
  | extend EventResult = iff(isempty(ErrorCode) and isempty(ErrorMessage), "Success", "Failure")
  | extend NewValue = iff(EventResult == "Success", case(
      EventName == "ApplySecurityGroupsToClientVpnTargetNetwork", ResponseElements.securityGroupIds,
      EventName == "AssociateClientVpnTargetNetwork", ResponseElements.associationId,
      EventName == "AttachVpnGateway", ResponseElements.attachment,
      EventName in ("AuthorizeClientVpnIngress", "CreateClientVpnRoute", "DeleteClientVpnRoute",
        "ExportClientVpnClientCertificateRevocationList", "RevokeClientVpnIngress"), ResponseElements.status,
      EventName == "CreateClientVpnEndpoint", ResponseElements.dnsName,
      EventName == "CreateCustomerGateway", ResponseElements.customerGateway,
      EventName == "CreateVpcEndpoint", ResponseElements.vpcEndpoint,
      EventName == "CreateVpcEndpointConnectionNotification", ResponseElements.connectionNotification,
      EventName == "CreateVpcEndpointServiceConfiguration", ResponseElements.serviceConfiguration,
      EventName == "CreateVpnConcentrator", ResponseElements.vpnConcentrator,
      EventName in ("CreateVpnConnection", "ModifyVpnConnection", "ModifyVpnConnectionOptions",
        "ModifyVpnTunnelCertificate", "ModifyVpnTunnelOptions"), ResponseElements.vpnConnection,
      EventName == "CreateVpnConnectionRoute", RequestParameters.DestinationCidrBlock,
      EventName == "CreateVpnGateway", ResponseElements.vpnGateway,
      EventName == "ExportClientVpnClientConfiguration", ResponseElements.clientConfiguration,
      EventName == "ModifyClientVpnEndpoint", RequestParameters.Description,
      EventName == "ModifyClientVpnEndpointAuthorizationPolicy", coalesce(RequestParameters.policyDocument,
        RequestParameters.PolicyDocument),
      EventName == "ModifyVpcEndpointPayerResponsibility", ResponseElements.payerResponsibilitySet,
      EventName == "ModifyVpcEndpointServicePayerResponsibility", RequestParameters.PayerResponsibility,
      EventName == "ModifyVpcEndpointServicePermissions", RequestParameters.AddAllowedPrincipals.N,
      EventName == "RejectVpcEndpointConnections", ResponseElements.unsuccessful,
      EventName == "ReplaceVpnTunnel", RequestParameters.VpnTunnelOutsideIpAddress,
      ""
    ), "")
  | extend ObjectId = case(
      EventName in ("AcceptVpcEndpointConnections", "DeleteVpcEndpointServiceConfigurations",
        "DescribeVpcEndpointServiceConfigurations", "DescribeVpcEndpointServicePermissions",
        "ModifyVpcEndpointServiceConfiguration", "ModifyVpcEndpointServicePayerResponsibility",
        "ModifyVpcEndpointServicePermissions", "StartVpcEndpointServicePrivateDnsVerification"),
        RequestParameters.ServiceId,
      EventName in ("ApplySecurityGroupsToClientVpnTargetNetwork", "AssociateClientVpnTargetNetwork",
        "AuthorizeClientVpnIngress", "CreateClientVpnRoute", "DeleteClientVpnEndpoint", "DeleteClientVpnRoute",
        "DescribeClientVpnAuthorizationRules", "DescribeClientVpnConnections", "DescribeClientVpnEndpoints",
        "DescribeClientVpnRoutes", "DescribeClientVpnTargetNetworks",
        "ExportClientVpnClientCertificateRevocationList", "ExportClientVpnClientConfiguration",
        "ModifyClientVpnEndpoint", "RevokeClientVpnIngress", "TerminateClientVpnConnections"),
        RequestParameters.ClientVpnEndpointId,
      EventName in ("AttachVpnGateway", "DetachVpnGateway"), RequestParameters.VpcId,
      EventName == "CreateClientVpnEndpoint", ResponseElements.clientVpnEndpointId,
      EventName == "CreateCustomerGateway", ResponseElements.customerGateway.customerGatewayId,
      EventName == "CreateVpcEndpoint", ResponseElements.vpcEndpoint.vpcEndpointId,
      EventName == "CreateVpcEndpointConnectionNotification",
        ResponseElements.connectionNotification.connectionNotificationId,
      EventName == "CreateVpcEndpointServiceConfiguration", ResponseElements.serviceConfiguration.serviceId,
      EventName == "CreateVpnConcentrator", ResponseElements.vpnConcentrator.vpnConcentratorId,
      EventName == "CreateVpnConnection", ResponseElements.vpnConnection.vpnConnectionId,
      EventName in ("CreateVpnConnectionRoute", "DeleteVpnConnection", "DeleteVpnConnectionRoute",
        "DescribeVpnConnections", "GetActiveVpnTunnelStatus", "GetVpnConnectionDeviceSampleConfiguration",
        "GetVpnTunnelReplacementStatus", "ModifyVpnConnection", "ModifyVpnConnectionOptions",
        "ModifyVpnTunnelCertificate", "ModifyVpnTunnelOptions", "ReplaceVpnTunnel"),
        RequestParameters.VpnConnectionId,
      EventName == "CreateVpnGateway", ResponseElements.vpnGateway.vpnGatewayId,
      EventName in ("DeleteClientVpnEndpointAuthorizationPolicy", "GetClientVpnEndpointAuthorizationPolicy",
        "ModifyClientVpnEndpointAuthorizationPolicy"), coalesce(RequestParameters.clientVpnEndpointId,
        RequestParameters.ClientVpnEndpointId),
      EventName in ("DeleteCustomerGateway", "DescribeCustomerGateways"), RequestParameters.CustomerGatewayId,
      EventName in ("DeleteVpcEndpointConnectionNotifications", "DescribeVpcEndpointConnectionNotifications",
        "ModifyVpcEndpointConnectionNotification"), RequestParameters.ConnectionNotificationId,
      EventName in ("DeleteVpcEndpoints", "DescribeVpcEndpointAssociations", "DescribeVpcEndpoints",
        "RejectVpcEndpointConnections"), RequestParameters.VpcEndpointId,
      EventName in ("DeleteVpnConcentrator", "DescribeVpnConcentrators"), RequestParameters.VpnConcentratorId,
      EventName in ("DeleteVpnGateway", "DescribeVpnGateways"), RequestParameters.VpnGatewayId,
      EventName == "DisassociateClientVpnTargetNetwork", ResponseElements.associationId,
      EventName == "ModifyVpcEndpoint", RequestParameters.RemoveRouteTableId.N,
      EventName == "ModifyVpcEndpointPayerResponsibility", coalesce(RequestParameters.vpcEndpointId,
        RequestParameters.VpcEndpointId),
      ""
    )
  | extend
      Type = "AWSCloudTrail",
      EventCount = int(1),
      EventStartTime = TimeGenerated,
      EventEndTime = TimeGenerated,
      EventSeverity = "Informational",
      EventSchema = "AuditEvent",
      EventSchemaVersion = "1.0.0",
      EventVendor = "AWS",
      EventProduct = "CloudTrail",
      Dvc = "CloudTrail",
      EventMessage = ErrorMessage,
      ObjectType = "Cloud Resource",
      TargetAppName = "Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud",
      TargetAppType = "Service"
  | project-rename
      EventOriginalSubType = EventTypeName,
      EventOriginalType = EventName,
      EventUid = AwsEventId,
      EventOriginalResultDetails = ErrorMessage,
      EventProductVersion = EventVersion,
      ActorUserId = UserIdentityAccountId,
      ActorUsername = UserIdentityUserName,
      ActorOriginalUserType = UserIdentityType,
      HttpUserAgent = UserAgent
  | extend
      ActorUserIdType = iff(isempty(ActorUserId), "", "AWSId"),
      ActorUsernameType = iff(isempty(ActorUsername), "", "Simple"),
      SrcIpAddr = iff(ipv4_is_in_range(SourceIpAddress, "0.0.0.0/0"), SourceIpAddress, ""),
      ActingApplicationEntityKey = "",
      ActorUserAdditionalIds = dynamic([]),
      ActorUserEntityKey = "",
      AdditionalEntities = dynamic([]),
      DvcEntityKey = "",
      SrcSystemEntityKey = "",
      TargetApplicationEntityKey = "",
      TargetSystemEntityKey = ""
  | extend AdditionalFields = iff(pack, bag_pack(
      "ActorAccessKeyId", UserIdentityAccessKeyId,
      "AWSRegion", AWSRegion,
      "APIVersion", APIVersion,
      "ManagementEvent", ManagementEvent,
      "ReadOnly", ReadOnly,
      "RequestParameters", RequestParameters,
      "ResponseElements", ResponseElements
    ), dynamic({}))
  | extend
      Operation = EventOriginalType,
      User = ActorUsername,
      IpAddr = SrcIpAddr,
      Application = TargetAppName,
      Value = NewValue
  | project
      TimeGenerated, Type, EventCount, EventStartTime, EventEndTime, EventSeverity,
      EventSchema, EventSchemaVersion, EventVendor, EventProduct, Dvc, EventResult,
      EventMessage, TargetAppName, EventOriginalSubType, EventOriginalType, EventUid,
      EventOriginalResultDetails, EventProductVersion, ActorUserId, ActorUsername,
      ActorOriginalUserType, HttpUserAgent, ActorUserIdType, ActorUsernameType,
      SrcIpAddr, AdditionalFields, User, IpAddr, Application, EventType, NewValue,
      Value, ObjectId, ObjectType, Object, TargetAppType, Operation,
      ActingApplicationEntityKey, ActorUserAdditionalIds, ActorUserEntityKey,
      AdditionalEntities, DvcEntityKey, SrcSystemEntityKey,
      TargetApplicationEntityKey, TargetSystemEntityKey
};
parser(disabled=disabled, pack=pack)
